name: ICONSIAM
tagline: Riverside mega-mall with floating market inside
taglineZh: 河畔超级商城，室内水上市场
description: ICONSIAM is Bangkok's most spectacular riverside mall, home to luxury flagships, the indoor ICONSIAM floating market (Sook Siam) with street food from all 77 provinces, nightly riverside light shows and a free shuttle boat from Saphan Taksin.
descriptionZh: ICONSIAM 是曼谷最壮观的河畔商城，汇集奢侈品牌旗舰店、室内水上市场 Sook Siam（汇集全泰77府街头美食）、每晚河畔灯光秀，并从郑皇桥站提供免费接驳船。

services.name: Sook Siam Floating Market Food Tour
services.nameZh: 暹罗天地水上市场美食之旅

services.name: Free Shuttle Boat from Saphan Taksin

location.address: 299 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600

name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
tagline: 15,000 stalls — the world's largest weekend market
taglineZh: 一万五千个摊位，全球最大周末市场
description: Chatuchak covers 27 sections and over 15,000 stalls selling everything from vintage clothes and artisan crafts to plants, pets and street food. Go early, carry small bills, and cool down with fresh coconut ice cream.
descriptionZh: 恰图恰市场分为27个区域、超过1.5万个摊位，从复古服饰、手工工艺品到绿植、宠物与街头小吃应有尽有。建议早去、备好零钱，再来一份椰子冰淇淋解暑。

services.name: Vintage & Handicraft Section Tour
services.nameZh: 复古手工艺区逛吃路线

name: Siam Paragon
tagline: The heart of Bangkok's shopping district
description: Siam Paragon anchors the Siam shopping district with luxury boutiques, the vast Gourmet Market food hall, an aquarium (Sea Life Bangkok) and direct BTS Siam access — the perfect one-stop stop between sightseeing and shopping.
descriptionZh: 暹罗百丽宫坐镇暹罗购物区核心，汇集奢侈精品店、超大的 Gourmet Market 美食超市、暹罗海洋世界水族馆，BTS 暹罗站直达，是观光购物的一站式枢纽。

services.name: Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World Ticket
